main_text.l: stas nominat alibi Dydimum, & Gregoriū Nazianzenum,&c.
Quæ cum mecum expenderem his die- bus, visum est eodem docendi genere vo- bis negotium Cœnæ domini explicare.
Proponam igitur vobis tanquam cate- chista inter catechumenos ex catechesi doctrinā veram de Cœna Domini: quem-admodum eam definitione expressit catechismus noster ,cuius verba sunt.
COENA DOMINI EST fidelium congregatio, in qua, dispensatione, & sumptione, &c.

AC quòd definitionem atti- net, satis illustris est: pro- priis enim verbis, & significantibus exprimit mētem Cœnæ, ideóq; retinet propriam virtutem definitionum, quæ est καθο- φνετα. Sumpta vero est ex cumulo causarum: non obscurè enim indicat authorem, modum, materiam,& finem cœnæ. Author K.ij.

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter. Some margin Greek words and the catchword marks are faint; the Greek in the right margin is read approximately. The signature "K.ij" is printed at the foot.
